step_1.name: GLOBAL mode API response validation
step_1.expected_result: Response includes mode=GLOBAL, productLevelReadiness object with aggregatedCompletionPct, segmentScores, missingGlobalAttributes, blockingSegments, sitesEvaluated
step_1.verification_method: DevTools Network tab, check request to /api/products/18/completion

step_2.name: UI site dropdown visibility
step_2.description: Verify ExportPage hides site dropdown and shows GLOBAL badge in GLOBAL mode
step_2.expected_result: Site dropdown hidden, GLOBAL badge visible, format dropdown visible
step_2.verification_method: Navigate to /export in GLOBAL mode, inspect UI

step_3.name: Export request payload validation
step_3.description: Verify export API call includes site='GLOBAL' in GLOBAL mode
step_3.verification_method: Click Export, inspect Network tab, check request body

step_4.name: SITE_SCOPED mode regression check
step_4.description: Verify SITE_SCOPED mode still shows site dropdown and sends site param
step_4.expected_result: Site dropdown visible, export payload has site=selected_site
step_4.verification_method: Disable GLOBAL flag, navigate to /export, verify UI and payload

step_5.name: Advanced toggle behavior
step_5.description: Verify Advanced toggle shows/hides siteStatus in GLOBAL mode
step_5.expected_result: Toggle expands to show per-site details, collapses to hide
step_5.verification_method: Click Advanced toggle, verify aria-expanded attr changes, sites visible
